column3: “a malicious witness” renders “a witness of violence (hamas).”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “justice” as the object of “pervert.”
“shall surely return” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
“lying helpless” renders “lying down”; the second half of the verse is difficult, and the meaning is uncertain.
NASB supplies “due” and “brother” in “the justice due to your needy brother.”
“a false charge” renders “a word of falsehood,” and “acquit the guilty” renders “declare righteous the wicked.”
“the feelings of a stranger” renders “the soul (nefesh) of the sojourner.”
“at the end of the year” renders “at the going out of the year.”
“the choice first fruits” renders “the beginning of the first fruits.”
“truly obey” renders an emphatic doubled verb, “listening you will listen.”
NASB supplies “the land of”; “completely destroy” renders “annihilate (cut off).”
“worship” renders “bow down to”; “utterly overthrow” and “break … in pieces” render doubled verbs.
“turn their backs to you” renders “give to you the neck.”
“hornets” renders the singular “the hornet”; the exact sense of the word is uncertain.
